summary: Xylem Inc. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (Rule 424(b)(5)) for a multi-tranche senior unsecured notes offering intended to finance all or a portion of the purchase price for an undisclosed Acquisition. Coupons, maturities, principal amounts and pricing are left blank in this preliminary filing. Notes carry a special mandatory redemption at 101% if the Acquisition is not consummated by the later of August 10, 2027 or an amended termination date, or if the equity purchase agreement is terminated. Proceeds are not escrowed. This is an ordinary financing takedown, not itself a special situation.
